name: Card
description: Composable contained surface for cards, modal bodies, drawers, popovers, toasts, and grouped content.

title.description: Legacy title slot. Rendered through Card.Title and Text.

description.description: Legacy description slot below title. Rendered through Card.Description and Text.

content.description: Legacy body slot. Strings render through Text with default control inset.

footer.description: Card footer slot. Use a structured component descriptor, for example Button.

variant.description: Surface preset for the container's role in the system.

padding.description: Internal surface inset. Default is the Face UI 7px contained-surface rhythm.

border.description: Whether the surface draws the membrane/border stroke.

interactive.description: Applies interactive hover surface behavior without making the card itself a button.

fullWidth.description: Whether the card stretches to the available inline size. When disabled, the card keeps intrinsic width and centers in the available inline space.

footerLayout.description: Legacy footer layout. Compound usage can set Card.Footer layout directly.

membrane.description: Membrane spacing state for the root surface.

children.description: Compound children or custom content escape hatch.

notes: Card is the shared contained-surface shell for other composed components.
Card separates visual surface presets from behavior; Modal still owns dialog behavior and can render its body through Card.
Title, description, string content and footer strings render through Text; Button descriptors receive membranes by default.
Flush square surfaces with padding none and radius none suppress the border automatically because they are already bounded by their parent edge.
The surface background is layered over an underlay token so transparency stays stable across parent backgrounds.

whenToUse: Shared contained surface for Modal, Drawer, Popover, Toast, and gallery examples
whenNotToUse: Clickable list item by itself (use Button or Tile for interaction semantics)
Full-page layout container without a contained surface role
Dialog behavior by itself (use Modal; Modal may compose Card internally)
